services.desc: We appreciate each and every one of you. Some of you we’ve known many years, others we’ve known for a shorter time. We want to let you know our horses are doing well, enjoying the sunshine (or possibly some whacky weather). We’ve set up this page in the event you’re wanting to help sponsor your favorite lesson horse. There are different sponsorship levels Dream Big Sponsorship $3001 Complimentary Lesson (groundwork and Riding ) Recognition on WSH Facebook Page T Shirt Reach for the Stars Sponsorship $ 2001/2 hour Complimentary Lesson (groundwork only) Recognition on WSH Facebook Page T

blurb: Guests participate in riding lessons and horsemanship training using natural horsemanship techniques to develop harmony with horses. Lessons include grooming, handling, roping, competitive trail riding preparation, schooling shows, cowboy dressage, liberty work, and both English and Western styles. Clinics and coaching at events are also offered.
